I have three and three-quarter hectares to look after, so I know I need to be smart about this beans plot. I will buy a small amount of fertilizer to help the beans start strong before the roots can fix their own nitrogen, and I must spray for insects because the bean pests here can destroy everything if you ignore them. My family will do most of the work, but during weeding and harvest time I will hire a few extra hands from the village so we finish on time. I am using the same seeds I kept from last season because the improved ones are too expensive and hard to find at the market.
